objects.description: During the [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) gained initial network access to some victims via a trojanized update of SolarWinds Orion software.(Citation: SolarWinds Sunburst Sunspot Update January 2021)(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory SVR TTP May 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Deep Dive Solorigate January 2021)
objects.description_fa: در طول [سازش SolarWinds](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024)، [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) از طریق یک به‌روزرسانی تروجان‌شده SolarWinds Orion، به برخی از قربانیان دسترسی اولیه به شبکه پیدا کرد. نرم افزار.(Citation: SolarWinds Sunburst Sunspot Update January 2021)(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory SVR TTP May 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Deep Dive Solorigate January 2021)
